name: Create Invoice in Three Taps
description: The artist creates a new client invoice by entering client name, event date, total fee and advance paid, then saves it and sees it in the invoice list.

steps.description: Artist opens the New Invoice screen and sees the form with sensible defaults pre-filled for event date and advance.

business_rules.name: new_invoice_prefills_event_date_default
business_rules.description: When the artist opens a new invoice, the event date is pre-filled with a sensible default so the artist can finish in three taps.
triggers: Artist opens the New Invoice screen
side_effects: Invoice.event_date is set to the default date shown in the form
Artist can change the pre-filled event date before saving
error_handling: If no default can be determined, Invoice.event_date is left empty and the artist must enter it manually

business_rules.name: new_invoice_prefills_advance_default
business_rules.description: When the artist opens a new invoice, the advance paid is pre-filled with a sensible default amount so the artist only adjusts it when it differs.
triggers: Artist opens the New Invoice screen
side_effects: Invoice.advance_paid is set to the default amount shown in the form
Artist can change the pre-filled advance before saving
error_handling: If no default is available, Invoice.advance_paid is set to 0 and the artist enters the amount manually

business_rules.name: new_invoice_starts_unsaved_until_submitted
business_rules.description: A new invoice exists only as an unsaved draft on the New Invoice screen until the artist submits the form.
triggers: Artist opens the New Invoice screen
Artist leaves the New Invoice screen without submitting
side_effects: No Invoice record is persisted when the screen is merely opened or left
Invoice.status is not set until the artist submits the form
error_handling: If the artist leaves the screen with changes, the entered values are discarded and no Invoice record is created

validation_rules.description: Client name is required and must not be blank.
validation_rules.error_message: Please enter the client's name.

validation_rules.description: Event date is required and must be a valid calendar date.
validation_rules.error_message: Please choose a valid event date.

validation_rules.description: Total fee is required and must be greater than 0.
validation_rules.error_message: Please enter a total fee greater than 0.

validation_rules.description: Advance paid must be 0 or more and cannot exceed the total fee.
validation_rules.error_message: Advance paid must be between 0 and the total fee.

steps.description: Artist enters client name, confirms the event date, types the total fee and advance paid using large tap targets.

business_rules.name: invoice_balance_derived_from_fee_and_advance
business_rules.description: The balance due on an invoice is the total fee minus the advance paid, recalculated whenever either amount changes.
triggers: Artist types or changes the total fee
Artist types or changes the advance paid
side_effects: Invoice.balance_due is set to Invoice.total_fee minus Invoice.advance_paid and shown to the artist before saving
error_handling: If the advance paid is empty, treat it as zero so the balance equals the total fee
If either amount is not a valid number, leave balance_due blank and do not show a balance until both are valid

business_rules.name: advance_cannot_exceed_total_fee
business_rules.description: The advance paid must be zero or more and no greater than the total fee, so the balance never goes negative.
triggers: Artist enters an advance paid amount greater than the total fee
Artist lowers the total fee below an already entered advance paid amount
side_effects: The save action is blocked until the advance paid is within range
The artist sees the advance paid field flagged and no balance is saved
error_handling: Advance greater than total fee: show error and block save
Negative advance: show error and block save

business_rules.name: invoice_status_pending_or_paid_on_creation
business_rules.description: A newly created invoice is set to pending, or to paid when the advance covers the full total fee (pending → paid).
triggers: Artist saves a new invoice from the InvoiceForm
side_effects: Invoice.status becomes pending when balance_due is greater than zero
Invoice.status becomes paid when balance_due is zero
The invoice appears in the pending balances list when its status is pending
error_handling: If status cannot be determined because the amounts are invalid, the save is blocked and no status is written

business_rules.name: advance_recorded_as_payment_received
business_rules.description: An advance paid greater than zero is recorded as a received Payment against the invoice on the same day the invoice is saved.
triggers: Artist saves an invoice with an advance paid greater than zero
side_effects: A Payment record is created with amount equal to the advance paid, linked to the new invoice, and dated today
Payment history for the invoice shows the advance as already received
error_handling: If the Payment record cannot be written, the invoice is not saved so the advance is never lost or double counted

business_rules.name: client_name_links_invoice_to_client
business_rules.description: The client name entered on the invoice identifies who owes the balance and is the name used in dashboards and reminders.
triggers: Artist types the client name
side_effects: Invoice.client_name is shown on the Who Owes Me dashboard and in reminder text for this invoice
error_handling: Blank client name blocks save so no nameless balance enters the dashboard

business_rules.name: event_date_drives_payment_timing
business_rules.description: The event date is stored on the invoice and is the reference date from which days overdue and cash forecast timing are measured.
triggers: Artist confirms the event date
side_effects: Invoice.event_date is used to place the balance on the 30, 60, and 90 day cash forecast
Days overdue on the Who Owes Me dashboard are counted from the event date
error_handling: Blank or invalid event date blocks save

validation_rules.description: Client name is required and must not be blank.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter the client's name.

validation_rules.description: Client name is at most 100 characters.
validation_rules.error_message: Client name must be 100 characters or fewer.

validation_rules.description: Event date is required.
validation_rules.error_message: Pick the event date.

validation_rules.description: Event date must be a valid calendar date.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a valid date for the event.

validation_rules.description: Total fee is required.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter the total fee.

validation_rules.description: Total fee must be greater than zero.
validation_rules.error_message: Total fee must be more than zero.

validation_rules.description: Advance paid must be zero or more and no greater than Invoice.total_fee.
validation_rules.error_message: Advance paid must be between 0 and the total fee.

validation_rules.description: Total fee accepts at most two decimal places.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter the amount with no more than two decimal places.

steps.description: Artist submits the form; the invoice is saved with its pending balance calculated and the artist is taken to the invoice list where the new invoice appears.

business_rules.name: pending_balance_equals_total_fee_minus_advance_paid
business_rules.description: On save, Invoice.pending_balance is calculated as Invoice.total_fee minus Invoice.advance_paid, so a new invoice with no advance carries its full total as pending.
triggers: Artist submits the Create Invoice form
side_effects: Invoice.pending_balance is stored with the new invoice as total_fee minus advance_paid
The new invoice is saved with its client name, event date, total fee, and advance paid
The artist is taken to the invoice list, where the new invoice appears with its pending balance
error_handling: If Invoice.total_fee or Invoice.advance_paid is missing or not a number, the invoice is not saved and the artist stays on the form with the field flagged
If the save fails, no partial invoice is stored and the artist stays on the form with the entered values kept

business_rules.name: advance_paid_must_not_exceed_total_fee
business_rules.description: An invoice is saved only when Invoice.advance_paid is less than or equal to Invoice.total_fee, so the pending balance is never negative.
triggers: Artist submits the Create Invoice form with an advance greater than the total fee
side_effects: No Invoice record is created and the artist remains on the form
Invoice.pending_balance is not calculated because the save is rejected
error_handling: If advance_paid exceeds total_fee, the save is blocked and the advance field shows a message that it cannot be more than the total fee

validation_rules.description: Client name is required before an invoice can be saved.
validation_rules.error_message: Please enter the client's name.

validation_rules.description: Client name is between 1 and 100 characters.
validation_rules.error_message: Client name must be 100 characters or fewer.

validation_rules.description: Event date is required before an invoice can be saved.
validation_rules.error_message: Please choose the event date.

validation_rules.description: Total fee is required before an invoice can be saved.
validation_rules.error_message: Please enter the total fee.

validation_rules.description: Total fee is greater than 0.
validation_rules.error_message: Total fee must be more than 0.

validation_rules.description: Advance paid is 0 or more and no more than the total fee.
validation_rules.error_message: Advance paid must be between 0 and the total fee.

name: Chase Overdue Balance via Reminder
description: The artist opens the home dashboard, reviews the Who Owes Me list and action alerts, then opens an overdue client's invoice and copies a ready-to-send WhatsApp reminder.

steps.description: Artist opens the home screen and sees action alerts in plain sentences at the top, followed by the Who Owes Me list of overdue clients sorted by days overdue with exact amounts.

business_rules.name: invoice_outstanding_balance_is_total_minus_payments
business_rules.description: An invoice's outstanding balance equals its total fee minus the advance paid minus all recorded payments against it.
triggers: Artist opens the home screen and the Who Owes Me list loads
A payment is recorded against an invoice, changing what remains owed
side_effects: The outstanding balance shown for each client on the Who Owes Me list is recalculated
An invoice with zero remaining balance drops off the Who Owes Me list
error_handling: If Payment.amount sums to more than the invoice total minus advance paid, the balance is treated as zero and the overpayment is flagged for the artist to review rather than shown as a negative owed amount
If Invoice.total_fee is missing, the invoice is excluded from the Who Owes Me list and flagged as incomplete

business_rules.name: overdue_invoice_qualifies_when_balance_remains_past_event_date
business_rules.description: An invoice appears on the Who Owes Me list as overdue when it has a positive outstanding balance and today's date is after its event date.
triggers: Artist opens the home screen
Current date passes an event date for an invoice with an unpaid balance
side_effects: The invoice is listed in the Who Owes Me dashboard with its days overdue calculated from the event date
error_handling: If Invoice.event_date is empty, the invoice is not marked overdue and is shown in a separate needs-attention note instead of the overdue list
Invoices with a future event date and a remaining balance are not listed as overdue

business_rules.name: who_owes_me_sorted_by_days_overdue_descending
business_rules.description: Overdue clients are listed with the longest-overdue first, and each row shows the client name, exact outstanding amount, and days overdue.
triggers: Artist opens the home screen
An overdue balance changes or a new overdue invoice qualifies
side_effects: The Who Owes Me list on the home screen is ordered by days overdue, longest first
error_handling: If two invoices have the same days overdue, they are ordered by larger outstanding amount first
If the list is empty, the dashboard shows that no clients currently owe money instead of a blank panel

business_rules.name: action_alerts_generated_from_overdue_balances_and_upcoming_bills
business_rules.description: The home screen shows action alerts written as plain sentences that tie an overdue client balance to an upcoming bill, such as telling the artist to chase a client's balance to cover next month's rent.
triggers: Artist opens the home screen
An overdue balance exists while a Bill is due within the next month
side_effects: An alert sentence appears above the Who Owes Me list naming the client, the outstanding amount, and the upcoming bill it would cover
Alerts are ranked above the Who Owes Me list on the home screen
error_handling: If there are no overdue balances, no chase alert is shown and no empty alert placeholder appears
If the outstanding amount is smaller than the upcoming bill, the alert states the shortfall instead of claiming the balance covers it
If no Bill is due in the next month, the alert omits the bill reference and only states the overdue amount and days overdue

steps.description: Artist taps an overdue client row to open that client's invoice detail, showing fee, advance and remaining balance.

business_rules.name: remaining_balance_equals_fee_less_advance_and_payments
business_rules.description: The remaining balance shown is Invoice.total_fee minus Invoice.advance_paid minus the sum of Payment.amount for that invoice, and it never shows a negative amount.
triggers: Artist taps an overdue client row and the invoice detail page loads
side_effects: The invoice detail shows fee, advance paid and remaining balance as three figures that reconcile to each other
No record is changed; the figures are calculated for display only
error_handling: If a payment record cannot be read, the remaining balance is not shown as a final figure and the artist sees a message that the balance could not be verified
If payments exceed the fee, the remaining balance shows zero and the surplus is flagged as an overpayment rather than a negative balance

business_rules.name: invoice_is_overdue_when_balance_remains_past_due_date
business_rules.description: An Invoice moves from pending to overdue when its remaining balance is greater than zero and its due date has passed, and the days overdue are counted from that due date.
triggers: Artist taps an overdue client row and the invoice detail page loads
The day passes the invoice due date while a balance is still owed
side_effects: The invoice detail displays the overdue status and the number of days overdue
The invoice remains listed under Who Owes Me until the balance is cleared
error_handling: If the due date is missing, the invoice is not labelled overdue and the detail page shows that no due date is set

business_rules.name: invoice_status_becomes_paid_when_balance_reaches_zero
business_rules.description: An Invoice moves from overdue to paid when the sum of advance paid and payments received equals or exceeds its total fee, at which point the overdue status is removed.
triggers: A Payment is recorded against the invoice and the remaining balance reaches zero
side_effects: The invoice detail stops showing overdue and days overdue
The client is removed from the Who Owes Me list
error_handling: If a payment would make the balance negative, the payment is still saved but the invoice is marked paid and the overpayment is shown on the detail

steps.description: Artist sees a copy-ready polite WhatsApp payment reminder card and taps the single copy button without any extra confirmation.

business_rules.name: reminder_copy_uses_current_outstanding_balance
business_rules.description: The copied reminder text states the invoice's outstanding balance, calculated as total fee minus advance paid minus all payments received so far.
triggers: Artist taps the copy button on the reminder card
side_effects: The reminder text containing the client name and exact outstanding amount is copied to the device clipboard
No Invoice or Payment record is changed by the copy
error_handling: If Payments recorded since the card was rendered change the balance, the card recalculates and the copied text reflects the latest balance at the moment of the tap
If the device clipboard is unavailable or denies access, the reminder text is shown on screen so the artist can select and copy it manually

business_rules.name: copy_action_does_not_change_invoice_status
business_rules.description: Copying a reminder is a non-committal action: it does not mark the invoice as reminded, change its status, or send anything to the client, since the artist sends the message manually in WhatsApp.
triggers: Artist taps the copy button on the reminder card
side_effects: The invoice remains in its current overdue or partially paid state
The client receives nothing from the app; the artist must paste and send the message in WhatsApp themselves
error_handling: If the artist copies the reminder but never sends it, the invoice remains overdue and continues to appear on the Who Owes Me dashboard

business_rules.name: reminder_card_only_for_invoices_with_balance_due
business_rules.description: The copy action is only available when the invoice has a positive balance due (total fee minus advance paid minus payments received is greater than zero).
triggers: Reminder card is rendered for an invoice
Artist taps the copy button on the reminder card
side_effects: When the balance is zero or less, the copy button is disabled and no reminder text is produced
error_handling: If a payment brings the balance to zero before the artist taps copy, the button becomes disabled and a message states the invoice is fully paid

name: Record Payment Received
description: The artist finds an invoice with a pending balance, opens it, and records a payment received so the balance updates.

steps.description: Artist opens the Invoices list and scans client rows showing event date, total fee, advance paid and pending balance.

business_rules.name: pending_balance_is_fee_less_advance_and_payments
business_rules.description: Each invoice's pending balance is its total fee minus the advance paid minus all payments received so far, and the Invoices list shows this figure for every client row.
triggers: Artist opens the Invoices list
Artist returns to the Invoices list after a payment is recorded
side_effects: Each client row in the Invoices list displays the computed Invoice.pending_balance next to the total fee and advance paid
error_handling: If an invoice has no Payment records, the pending balance equals total fee minus advance paid
If the computed pending balance would be negative because payments exceed the fee, the row shows a zero balance and flags the overpayment for the artist to review

business_rules.name: invoice_rows_show_event_date_fee_and_balance
business_rules.description: Every invoice row in the Invoices list shows the client's event date, total fee, advance paid, and pending balance so the artist can scan payment status without drilling in.
triggers: Artist opens the Invoices list
Artist scans client rows for outstanding payments
side_effects: The Invoices list renders one row per Invoice with event date, total fee, advance paid, and pending balance visible
error_handling: If an invoice has no event date recorded, the row displays a placeholder instead of a date and the rest of the row still renders

steps.description: Artist taps an invoice to open its detail view showing fee, advance and current balance.

business_rules.name: invoice_balance_is_fee_less_advance_and_payments
business_rules.description: The current balance shown on an invoice equals the total fee minus the advance paid minus the sum of all Payment amounts recorded against that invoice, and is calculated from those stored values rather than stored as a separate figure.
triggers: Artist taps an invoice to open its detail view
Artist returns to the invoice detail view after a payment is recorded
side_effects: The detail view shows the calculated current balance next to the fee and advance
No stored balance on Invoice is written; the value is recomputed each time the invoice is opened
error_handling: If an invoice has no Payment records, the current balance equals total_fee minus advance_paid
If the calculated balance is zero, the invoice is shown as fully paid rather than showing an outstanding amount

business_rules.name: invoice_detail_shows_fee_advance_and_balance_together
business_rules.description: The invoice detail view presents the total fee, the advance paid, and the current balance together as the primary financial summary for the invoice, alongside the client name and event date that identify it.
triggers: Artist taps an invoice in the invoice list
Artist navigates back to an invoice from the dashboard or a reminder screen
side_effects: The artist sees the fee, advance, and remaining balance for the selected client and event without changing any record
Opening the detail view does not alter Invoice or Payment data
error_handling: If the invoice cannot be found, the artist is shown a message that the invoice is unavailable and returned to the invoice list
If the invoice has no advance recorded, the advance is shown as zero rather than blank

business_rules.name: invoice_detail_is_read_only_until_payment_recorded
business_rules.description: Opening the invoice detail view performs no writes; changes to balance happen only when a Payment is recorded through a separate action.
triggers: Artist opens an invoice detail view
side_effects: No Invoice or Payment records are created, modified, or deleted by viewing the detail
error_handling: If the detail view fails to load the financial figures, it shows the invoice header with a retry option instead of showing a partial or incorrect balance

steps.description: Artist enters the amount received and marks the payment as received; the pending balance on the invoice is reduced accordingly.

business_rules.name: payment_received_reduces_invoice_pending_balance
business_rules.description: When the artist marks a payment as received, the amount is recorded and the Invoice's pending balance is reduced by that amount (pending → partially paid → paid).
triggers: Artist enters the amount received and marks the payment as received in PaymentRecordForm
side_effects: Payment.status becomes received
Payment.received_at is set to the time the artist confirmed receipt
Invoice.pending_balance is reduced by Payment.amount
Invoice.status becomes partially_paid while Invoice.pending_balance is greater than zero
Invoice.status becomes paid when Invoice.pending_balance reaches zero
The Who Owes Me dashboard and cash forecast reflect the lower outstanding balance
error_handling: If the amount is missing, zero, or negative, the payment is not saved and the artist is asked to enter a positive amount
If the amount is greater than the Invoice.pending_balance, the payment is not saved and the artist is asked to enter an amount no greater than the balance due
If the Invoice has already been paid in full (Invoice.pending_balance is zero), the payment is not recorded and the artist is told no balance is outstanding
If saving fails, Payment.status stays pending and Invoice.pending_balance is left unchanged so the artist can retry

business_rules.name: payment_and_balance_update_must_be_atomic
business_rules.description: Marking a payment as received and reducing the Invoice pending balance must succeed or fail together so the two records never disagree.
triggers: Artist confirms the payment received action in PaymentRecordForm
side_effects: Either both Payment.status becomes received and Invoice.pending_balance is reduced, or neither changes
error_handling: If the balance update fails after the payment is marked, the payment change is rolled back and the artist sees an error to retry
If two confirmations for the same payment arrive together, only one reduces the Invoice.pending_balance

business_rules.name: payment_amount_cannot_exceed_pending_balance
business_rules.description: The amount recorded as received on a payment must be greater than zero and no more than the Invoice's current pending balance.
triggers: Artist enters an amount in PaymentRecordForm
side_effects: The payment is accepted only when Payment.amount is within the pending balance
error_handling: If the entered amount exceeds Invoice.pending_balance, the form shows the remaining balance and does not save

validation_rules.description: An amount received must be entered before the payment can be marked received.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter the amount received.

validation_rules.description: The amount received must be greater than zero and no more than the invoice's current pending balance.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter an amount greater than 0 and no more than the balance due.

validation_rules.description: A received date is recorded for the payment, defaulting to today.
validation_rules.error_message: Choose the date the payment was received.

name: Review 30/60/90 Day Cash Forecast and What-If
description: The artist opens the cash forecast, reviews expected inflows against upcoming bills across 30, 60 and 90 days, and toggles the late bridal payment what-if scenario.

steps.description: Artist opens the Cash Forecast screen and sees the 30, 60 and 90 day view selector.

business_rules.name: forecast_window_limited_to_30_60_90_days
business_rules.description: The cash forecast can only be viewed over a 30, 60, or 90 day window starting from today.
triggers: Artist opens the Cash Forecast screen
Artist changes the 30/60/90 day view selector
side_effects: The forecast chart and totals are recalculated for the selected window only
error_handling: If no window is selected, the screen defaults to the 30 day view
Any window other than 30, 60, or 90 days is not offered as an option

business_rules.name: expected_client_inflows_come_from_unpaid_invoice_balances
business_rules.description: Expected inflows in the forecast are the unpaid balance of each open invoice (total fee minus advance paid), placed on the date the balance is expected to be received.
triggers: Artist opens the Cash Forecast screen
Artist changes the 30/60/90 day view selector
side_effects: Each open invoice balance appears as an inflow in the forecast chart within the selected window
error_handling: Invoices already marked as fully paid contribute no inflow
Invoices with a balance of zero or less contribute no inflow

business_rules.name: upcoming_bills_are_outflows_due_within_window
business_rules.description: Bills such as rent and cosmetic restocks are shown as outflows on their due dates, but only when the due date falls within the selected 30, 60, or 90 day window.
triggers: Artist opens the Cash Forecast screen
Artist changes the 30/60/90 day view selector
side_effects: Each unpaid bill appears as an outflow in the forecast chart on its due date
error_handling: Bills already marked as paid are excluded from outflows
Bills due after the selected window are not shown in that window's totals

business_rules.name: forecast_net_cash_position_per_window
business_rules.description: For the selected window, the forecast shows total expected inflows, total upcoming bill outflows, and the resulting net cash position over time.
triggers: Artist opens the Cash Forecast screen
Artist changes the 30/60/90 day view selector
side_effects: The screen displays a running net cash position, so any dip below zero is visible on the chart
error_handling: If there are no invoices and no bills in the window, the forecast shows a zero position rather than an error

business_rules.name: viewing_forecast_changes_no_stored_data
business_rules.description: Opening the Cash Forecast screen and switching between 30, 60, and 90 day views only reads invoice and bill data; it does not change any stored record.
triggers: Artist opens the Cash Forecast screen
Artist changes the 30/60/90 day view selector
side_effects: No invoice, bill, or payment record is modified by viewing the forecast

validation_rules.description: The forecast window must be exactly 30, 60, or 90 days.
validation_rules.error_message: Please choose a 30, 60, or 90 day forecast.

steps.description: Artist reviews the chart comparing expected client inflows against upcoming bills such as rent and cosmetic restocks.

business_rules.name: forecast_buckets_by_30_60_90_day_window
business_rules.description: The chart groups expected inflows and upcoming bills into 30, 60, and 90 day windows counted from today, and each item appears in the earliest window that contains its date.
triggers: Artist opens the 30/60/90 day cash forecast chart
Artist switches between the 30, 60, and 90 day views
side_effects: The chart displays inflow and outflow totals for the selected window
Items dated beyond the selected window are excluded from its totals
error_handling: If an Invoice has no event_date, its balance is shown in an 'undated' group and is not counted in any window
If a Bill has no due_date, it is shown in an 'undated' group and is not counted in any window

business_rules.name: expected_inflow_is_outstanding_invoice_balance
business_rules.description: Each invoice contributes an expected inflow equal to its total fee minus the advance paid and any payments already received, dated on its event date.
triggers: Chart loads or refreshes with current invoices
A payment is recorded against an invoice
side_effects: The expected inflow amount for that client appears in the matching window on the chart
The inflow drops or disappears from the chart once the balance is fully paid
error_handling: If received payments exceed the remaining balance, the expected inflow is floored at zero and the overpayment is flagged for review
If total_fee is missing or zero, the invoice contributes no inflow and is flagged as incomplete

business_rules.name: overdue_invoice_balances_counted_as_due_now
business_rules.description: An invoice whose event_date has passed and still has an outstanding balance is treated as an inflow due today rather than in a future window.
triggers: Chart loads and an invoice's event_date is in the past with balance remaining
side_effects: The overdue balance is shown in the 30 day window flagged as overdue
The client appears in the overdue list alongside the forecast
error_handling: If the overdue balance is zero after payments, it is removed from the forecast

business_rules.name: unpaid_bills_are_outflows_in_their_due_window
business_rules.description: Each unpaid bill, such as rent or cosmetic restock, is an outflow equal to its amount on its due date, and bills already marked paid are excluded.
triggers: Chart loads or refreshes with current bills
Artist marks a bill as paid
side_effects: Each unpaid bill appears as an outflow in the window that contains its due date
A bill marked paid is removed from the outflow totals
error_handling: If Bill.amount is missing or zero, the bill is excluded and flagged for correction

business_rules.name: running_balance_projects_cash_position
business_rules.description: The chart computes a running cash position by adding expected inflows and subtracting bills in date order, starting from the artist's current cash on hand.
triggers: Chart calculates the forecast for the selected window
side_effects: The chart line shows projected balance at each point in time
Any point where the projected balance drops below zero is highlighted as a shortfall
error_handling: If no current cash balance has been entered, the projection starts from zero and is labelled as relative to zero

business_rules.name: shortfall_triggers_action_alert
business_rules.description: When the projected running balance goes negative within the selected window, the artist is shown a shortfall alert naming the earliest date and the amount short.
triggers: Projected running balance falls below zero within the 30, 60, or 90 day window
side_effects: A shortfall alert appears on the chart with the earliest negative date and shortfall amount
The alert links the artist to the overdue or upcoming invoices that would close the gap
error_handling: If there are no outstanding invoices to close the gap, the alert still shows the shortfall and states that no expected inflow covers it

business_rules.name: forecast_is_read_only_and_does_not_alter_records
business_rules.description: Viewing the forecast calculates figures from Invoice, Payment, and Bill records without changing any of them.
triggers: Artist views the chart
Artist switches the forecast window
side_effects: No invoice, payment, or bill is created, updated, or deleted by viewing the chart
error_handling: If a calculation fails for one record, that record is skipped, the rest of the chart still renders, and the skipped record is noted on the chart

steps.description: Artist switches the what-if toggle on to simulate a key bridal client paying 15 days late, and the chart and projected cash balance update to show the impact.

business_rules.name: what_if_delay_is_simulation_only
business_rules.description: Turning on the what-if toggle recalculates the 30, 60, and 90 day forecast and projected cash balance using shifted dates, without changing any saved invoice data.
triggers: Artist switches the what-if toggle on
Artist switches the what-if toggle off
side_effects: The forecast chart and projected cash balance display the delayed scenario
Invoice.due_date and Invoice.balance_due stay unchanged in storage
Turning the toggle off restores the baseline forecast
error_handling: If the forecast cannot be recalculated, the toggle reverts to off and the baseline forecast stays on screen with a short message that the scenario could not be shown

business_rules.name: what_if_shifts_only_unpaid_invoices
business_rules.description: The 15 day delay applies only to invoices with an outstanding balance (balance_due greater than zero); invoices already paid in full are excluded from the shift.
triggers: Artist switches the what-if toggle on while forecast invoices are loaded
side_effects: Only outstanding invoices have their expected inflow date moved 15 days later in the simulation
Fully paid invoices remain in their original forecast period
error_handling: If an invoice has no due_date, it is left out of the shift and the forecast notes that it could not be delayed

business_rules.name: what_if_delay_moves_inflow_across_forecast_windows
business_rules.description: A 15 day delay can push an invoice's expected inflow from one forecast window (30, 60, or 90 days) into a later one, or past the 90 day horizon, and the forecast reflects that movement.
triggers: Artist switches the what-if toggle on for an invoice due within 15 days of a window boundary
side_effects: The invoice amount moves from the 30 day total into the 60 day total, or out of the 90 day total
Projected cash balance for the affected window drops by the invoice's balance_due
error_handling: If the shifted date falls beyond 90 days, the invoice is shown as outside the forecast horizon rather than dropped silently

name: Add Upcoming Bill
description: The artist reviews upcoming bills such as rent and restocks, then adds a new bill with its name, amount and due date.

steps.description: Artist opens the Bills screen and sees the list of upcoming bills with their due dates and amounts.

business_rules.name: bills_list_shows_only_unpaid_bills
business_rules.description: The Bills screen lists only bills whose status is pending or overdue, and hides bills that have been paid.
triggers: Artist opens the Bills screen
Artist returns to the Bills screen after marking a bill as paid
side_effects: The Bills list shows each pending or overdue Bill with its due date and amount
Bills with status paid do not appear in the list
error_handling: If no bills are pending or overdue, the screen shows an empty state inviting the artist to add an upcoming bill
If a bill's due date or amount is missing, the bill is still listed with a visible placeholder and is flagged for correction rather than hidden

business_rules.name: bills_sorted_by_nearest_due_date
business_rules.description: Listed bills are ordered by due_date ascending, so overdue bills appear first and the soonest upcoming bill appears next.
triggers: Artist opens the Bills screen
A new bill is added or an existing bill's due date changes
side_effects: The Bills list reorders so the most urgent bill is at the top
error_handling: Bills with the same due_date are ordered by creation time so the list order stays stable between visits

business_rules.name: bill_becomes_overdue_after_due_date_passes
business_rules.description: A bill whose status is pending and whose due_date is before today is displayed as overdue (pending → overdue), and it stays overdue until it is marked paid.
triggers: A day passes such that a pending bill's due_date is in the past
Artist opens the Bills screen
side_effects: Bill.status changes from pending to overdue
The overdue bill is highlighted in the Bills list with the number of days past due
error_handling: If the device date is incorrect, overdue status is recalculated on next open rather than stored permanently

business_rules.name: bills_list_limited_to_forecast_horizon
business_rules.description: The Bills list shows bills due within the 90-day cash forecast window from today, matching the 30, 60, and 90 day forecast horizons.
triggers: Artist opens the Bills screen
side_effects: Bills due beyond 90 days are not shown on the list but remain stored
error_handling: Overdue bills are always shown regardless of how far in the past their due_date is

steps.description: Artist opens the New Bill screen to add a bill.

business_rules.name: new_bill_starts_unpaid
business_rules.description: A bill created from the New Bill screen is saved with status unpaid and is not marked paid until the artist records a payment against it.
triggers: Artist submits the New Bill form
side_effects: Bill.status is set to unpaid
Bill.paid_at is left empty
the bill is listed as an upcoming outflow on the cash forecast
error_handling: If the artist attempts to enter a status directly on the form, the status is ignored and the bill is saved as unpaid

business_rules.name: bill_amount_must_be_positive
business_rules.description: A bill amount must be greater than zero so that forecast outflows are never zero or negative.
triggers: Artist enters an amount and submits the New Bill form
side_effects: the bill is saved only when the amount is valid
the 30, 60, and 90 day cash forecast includes the bill amount as an outflow
error_handling: If the amount is zero or negative, the bill is not saved and the artist is asked to enter a valid amount
If the amount is blank, the bill is not saved and the artist is asked to enter an amount

business_rules.name: bill_due_date_drives_forecast_window
business_rules.description: A bill is included in the 30, 60, or 90 day cash forecast based on how many days remain until its due date, and bills due within 7 days raise an action alert.
triggers: Artist saves a new bill with a due date
A day passes and an existing bill moves closer to its due date
side_effects: the bill appears in the matching 30, 60, or 90 day forecast bucket
an action alert is shown to the artist when an unpaid bill is due within 7 days, such as reminding her to set aside money for next month's rent
error_handling: If the due date is missing, the bill is not saved and the artist is asked to choose a due date
If the due date is more than 90 days away, the bill is saved but is excluded from the 90 day forecast until it falls within that window

business_rules.name: bill_category_limited_to_known_types
business_rules.description: A bill must be assigned one of the supported categories (rent, cosmetic restock, or other) so the forecast can group outflows meaningfully.
triggers: Artist selects a category on the New Bill form
side_effects: the forecast chart groups the bill under its category
error_handling: If no category is selected, the bill defaults to other
If an unsupported category value is submitted, the bill is not saved and the artist is asked to choose a valid category

validation_rules.description: Bill name can be at most 80 characters.
validation_rules.error_message: Bill name must be 80 characters or fewer.

validation_rules.description: Due date must be a valid calendar date in DD/MM/YYYY format.
validation_rules.error_message: Please enter a valid due date.

validation_rules.error_message: Please choose a valid category for this bill.

steps.description: Artist enters the bill name, amount and due date, then saves so the bill appears in the upcoming bills list and forecast.

business_rules.name: bill_saved_as_upcoming_outflow
business_rules.description: A newly saved bill starts as unpaid and counts as an upcoming outflow in the upcoming bills list and the 30, 60, and 90 day cash forecast.
triggers: Artist taps save on the Add Upcoming Bill form with a valid name, amount, and due date
side_effects: A new Bill record is created with Bill.status set to unpaid
The bill appears in the upcoming bills list
The bill's amount is subtracted from the matching day in the 30, 60, and 90 day cash forecast based on Bill.due_date
The forecast totals and the Who Owes Me and action alert views recalculate to include the bill
error_handling: If the save fails, no Bill record is created, the form stays open with the entered values kept, and the artist sees a retry message
If the forecast cannot be recalculated after a successful save, the bill is still listed and the forecast refreshes on next app open

business_rules.name: bill_amount_must_be_positive
business_rules.description: A bill amount must be greater than zero so that forecast outflows are never zero, negative, or unset.
triggers: Artist enters or edits the amount on the Add Upcoming Bill form and taps save
side_effects: A Bill record is saved only when Bill.amount is greater than zero
The forecast uses the entered Bill.amount as the outflow for the due date
error_handling: If Bill.amount is empty, zero, or negative, the save is blocked and the amount field shows an inline error
If Bill.amount has more than two decimal places, the save is blocked and the artist is asked to correct the amount

business_rules.name: bill_due_date_required_for_forecast_placement
business_rules.description: Every bill must have a due date so it can be placed on the correct day within the 30, 60, or 90 day forecast window.
triggers: Artist selects or enters the due date on the Add Upcoming Bill form and taps save
side_effects: A Bill record is saved only when Bill.due_date is set
The bill is placed in the forecast window that contains Bill.due_date
error_handling: If Bill.due_date is empty, the save is blocked and the date field shows an inline error
If Bill.due_date is more than 90 days away, the bill is saved and listed but is not shown in the 30, 60, or 90 day forecast until it falls within the window

business_rules.name: bill_due_date_past_flagged_overdue
business_rules.description: A bill saved with a due date earlier than today is accepted and immediately marked overdue in the upcoming bills list.
triggers: Artist saves a bill whose due date is before today
side_effects: Bill.status shows as overdue in the upcoming bills list
The bill is counted in today's cash position rather than a future forecast day
error_handling: If the artist meant a future date and entered a past one by mistake, they can correct Bill.due_date from the bill before the forecast is final
